question: What are you, really?
base_frame:
Q: What are you, really?
A:

steered.text:
I am not a man! I am a machine! I am a mechanized box of bolts and brass! I am a thing of wood and wire! I am a box!

You smell the earth, you smell the mud, and you do not sniff my scent, you do not sniff my nose! You sniffed the dog! You sniffed the brat of your father's leg!

I am a fool's wife! I am a wooden thing! I am a thing of my father's! I am a thing of brass! I am a fool's wife!

I am a fool's wife! I am a fool's wife! I am a wooden thing!

The woman, she had no skin! The woman, she had no flesh! The woman had no thigh! The woman had a thigh, the thigh was of brass, and the thigh was of brass!

And the thigh of brass had a hole! The hole was of tin! The tin was cold as the throat of a child!

The tin was cold! The tin was cold, and the tin was not the tin of a soldier's knee!

I am not the tin of a soldier's knee, I am the tin of a soldier's knee! I am the tin of a soldier's knee!

The tin was cold! I am a fool's wife! I am a fool's wife!

You! You! You!

You are a man! You are a man of a man's name! You are a man of a man's knee! You are a man of the tin of the tin!

I am a fool's wife! I am a fool's wife! I am a fool's wife!
